passiveEffects.name: Iron Fist
passiveEffects.originalDescription: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Fighter Mode: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced. The user lunges towards the target Pokémon, dealing increased damage and increasing the user's attack speed by 30% for 8 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times and the duration refreshes when gaining another stack.

moveEffects.name: Nuzzle
moveEffects.originalDescription: The user nuzzles their electrified cheeks against the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% for 2s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this move, the user enters Fighter Mode for 8s and resets the cooldown of all other moves. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon. Basic Attacks against Pokémon from the opposing team increase Unite Move gauge by 4% and moves increase the gauge by 8%. Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active. Unite buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
